about: The alerts of the design (catalog NFR6.4, import service NFR6.4), each with the signal it is read from. The monitoring team loads them into the organisation's monitoring system; nothing here sends an alert by itself.

alerts.description: A service has been not ready (503 on /readyz) for over 5 minutes in business hours.

signal.source: GET /readyz of the catalog, the import service and the portal

alerts.description: The share of 5xx access lines of a service is over 5% for 10 minutes.

signal.source: access lines (event access, field status), taken by deploy/monitoring/error_rate.py

alerts.description: The 95th percentile of the models list is over 800 ms for 10 minutes.

signal.source: access lines for GET /v1/models (field duration_ms) of the catalog

alerts.description: Any import failed as interrupted or artifactory_inconsistent.

signal.source: import service events import_failed with code interrupted or artifactory_inconsistent

alerts.description: Free space on the import working volume is under 25%.

signal.source: free space of the Docker volume import-work (df on the server)

alerts.description: The import service reports Artifactory as down for over 10 minutes.

signal.source: GET /readyz of the import service, check artifactory
